Lann Tarv is a merchant on the ground floor of Moonrise Towers in Act Two. His special inventory is not available unless the party pass certain checks with  Z'rell after the introduction scene further within Moonrise Towers.
“
Hah! Bark, bark. Like a worg pup, you are.
„
— Lann Tarv, mocking the player character

Involvement

Act Two

Soul Coins

If Lann Tarv is approached with  Karlach in the active party, there is an opportunity to receive three  Soul Coins left with him on behalf of Florenta the Garrotter, on condition that Karlach listens to him while he tells the stories behind each of the three souls they contain. Although this is a devil's bargain, accepting these coins has no documented negative effects or approval changes. The player character can initially refuse the coins - offered by a devil - as "too risky" but still accept them after at Karlach's behest. Ultimately refusing the deal despite Karlach strongly suggesting otherwise causes -5 disapproval.

If the party ultimately refuse the deal, or if Karlach is not present, the soul coins may still be acquired by theft or purchase.

Getting lower prices

The party can get better prices from him by suggesting he will not sell many wares with his attitude. Then, when he asks the interacting party member to prove their worth, they can respond:

  • [HAG-EYED] [PERSUASION] Bet the hag who ripped my eye out is howling from the grave. (DC 6)
  • [PERSUASION] If your stomach's strong enough, I'll tell you how I lost this eye. (DC 14) (if Volo removed eye)
  • [WYLL] [INTIMIDATION] The bastards who took my eye aren't singing. They're screaming in the Hells. (DC 14)
  • [PERSUASION] The Absolute is. I burned that druids' grove to the ground. (DC 6)
  • [PERSUASION] Dror Ragzlin isn't. I ripped him and his camp apart. (DC 14)
  • [KARLACH] [PERSUASION] The demons of the abyss sing my name and tremble. (DC 14)
  • [INTIMIDATION] You'll be shrieking my name if you keep asking innane questions. (DC 16)
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] No songs. Just screams. (DC 16 )
  • [PERSUASION] Nobody sings my name - I don't leave any witnesses. (DC 16)
  • [EVIL CLERIC] [PERSUASION] The gods - when I slit my enemies' throats and offer their lives up as tribute. (DC 16 )
  • [GOOD CLERIC] [PERSUASION] Those who bathe in the warmth and light of the one I serve. (DC 16 )
  • [CLERIC] [PERSUASION] Friends and enemies alike - for I wield the power of the divine with the ease of breathing. (DC 16 )
  • [WILD MAGIC] [PERSUASION] Depends on what my magic summons - could be anything from a cow to a mephit. But they're all very musical, I assure you. (DC 16 )
  • [DRACONIC BLOODLINE] [PERSUASION] My dragonblood sings every time I burn an enemy alive. (DC 16 )
  • [SORCERER] [PERSUASION] The skies themselves - when they bow to my magic and unleash a tidal wave of power. (DC 16 )
  • [BARD] [PERSUASION] Well, I mainly do the singing. Usually while beating my foes to a pulp - it's quite the sight. (DC 16 )
  • [ROGUE] [PERSUASION] Nobody sings my name - I don't leave any witnesses. (DC 16 )
  • [GLOOM STALKER RANGER] [PERSUASION] Footprints in untrodden places sing my travels and trials. (DC 16 )
  • [FIGHTER] [PERSUASION] Check the calluses on my hands. Those come only from a steadfast grip on a weapon. (DC 16 )
  • [MONK] [PERSUASION] Check my knuckles - I've felled plenty of foes with my fists alone. (DC 16 )
  • [OATH OF VENGEANCE] [INTIMIDATION] The sinners who've fallen in the face of righteous justice. (DC 16 )
  • [OATH OF THE ANCIENTS] [INTIMIDATION] Forgotten glades and eternal streams whisper their protector's name. (DC 16 )
  • [OATH OF DEVOTION] [INTIMIDATION] Those I am sworn to protect. (DC 16 )
  • [OATH OF THE CROWN] [INTIMIDATION] Citizens of the realm - everyone from paupers to kings. (DC 16 )
  • [OATHBREAKER] [INTIMIDATION] Those who'd bind another to their will whisper my name in nightmares. (DC 16 )
  • [GALE] [PERSUASION] Perhaps 'warrior' isn't the right word. But I could turn this tower to dust without twitching my finger. (DC 16)
  • [LAE'ZEL] [INTIMIDATION] Open shop, or it will be you howling my name and begging my mercies. (DC 16)
  • [ASTARION] [DECEPTION] Oh, no one sings it. But hundreds have died sobbing with my name on their lips. (DC 16)
  • [SHADOWHEART] [INTIMIDATION] Screaming my name, more like. I know how to inflict pain. Show respect, or I'll give you a demonstration. (DC 16)
  • [DARK URGE] [INTIMIDATION] I have cut from corpses a thousand tongues, and those thousand tongues sing of murder. (DC 16)
  • [WIZARD] [PERSUASION] The Weave itself - for I traverse its depths with the ease of breathing. (DC 16 )
  • [DRUID] [PERSUASION] Nature's beasts - with fangs of fury and unsheathed claw. (DC 16 )

Doing so increases his attitude to the maximum (100) and grants one of the following inspirations:

  • ⁠Uncommon Recognition ( Folk Hero backgrounds)
  • ⁠Notched Armour ( Soldier backgrounds)
